test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A pipe can fill an empty tank in 15 minutes while another pipe can empty the same fully filled tank in 20 minutes. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then how much time (in minutes) will it take to completely fill the empty tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Filling pipe can fill the tank in 15 minutes.

Emptying pipe can empty the tank in 20 minutes.

**Calculations:**

**Step 1: Calculate the Rates of the Pipes**

⇒ Rate of filling pipe = 1 tank / 15 minutes = 1/15 tanks per minute

⇒ Rate of emptying pipe = 1 tank / 20 minutes = 1/20 tanks per m
